programme.title: Fiddler on the Roof
programme.desc: A lavishly produced and critically acclaimed screen adaptation of the international stage sensation tells the life-affirming story of Tevye, a poor milkman whose love, pride and faith help him face the oppression of turn-of-the-century czarist Russia.

programme.title: Max
programme.desc: After U.S. Marine Kyle Wincott is killed in Afghanistan, Max, his highly trained service dog, is too traumatized to remain in service. Back in the U.S., Kyle's family adopts the dog, but teenage brother Justin has problems of his own and doesn't want the animal. However, Max may be Justin's only chance to learn what really happened to his brother. With the help of a dog-savvy friend, Justin and Max begin to bond, and set out to unravel the mystery of Kyle's death.

programme.title: An Inconvenient Sequel: Truth to Power
programme.desc: Former Vice President Al Gore continues his tireless fight, traveling around the world to train an army of activists and influence international climate policy. Cameras follow him behind the scenes -- in moments both private and public, funny and poignant -- as he pursues the inspirational idea that while the stakes have never been higher, the perils of climate change can be overcome with human ingenuity and passion.

programme.title: A Christmas Carol
programme.desc: Dickens' London miser Ebenezer Scrooge (George C. Scott) meets the ghosts of Christmases past, present and yet to come.

programme.title: The Crying Game
programme.desc: Irish Republican Army member Fergus (Stephen Rea) forms an unexpected bond with Jody (Forest Whitaker), a kidnapped British soldier in his custody, despite the warnings of fellow IRA members Jude (Miranda Richardson) and Maguire (Adrian Dunbar). Jody makes Fergus promise he'll visit his girlfriend, Dil (Jaye Davidson), in London, and when Fergus flees to the city, he seeks her out. Hounded by his former IRA colleagues, he finds himself increasingly drawn to the enigmatic, and surprising, Dil.

programme.title: Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: When a group of civil rights workers goes missing in a small Mississippi town, FBI agents Alan Ward (Willem Dafoe) and Rupert Anderson (Gene Hackman) are sent in to investigate. Local authorities refuse to cooperate with them, and the African American community is afraid to, precipitating a clash between the two agents over strategy. As the situation becomes more volatile, the direct approach is abandoned in favor of more aggressive, hard-line tactics.

programme.title: Colors
programme.desc: In this gritty police drama from director Dennis Hopper, street-wise cop Bob Hodges (Robert Duvall) and hotheaded rookie Danny McGavin (Sean Penn) grapple with their new partnership on the gang-ridden streets of Los Angeles. Although Danny finally lets Hodges show him the ropes, his adrenaline-fed brutality earns him a reputation with the very gangs they want to help. With a gang war ready to explode, Danny confronts his own racism even as he falls in love with Louisa (Maria Conchita Alonso).

programme.title: Out of Time
programme.desc: Matt Lee Whitlock (Denzel Washington) is the police chief of a small Florida town, going through a divorce with his detective wife, Alex (Eva Mendes). He begins a passionate affair with Ann (Sanaa Lathan), only to find out that she's stricken with terminal cancer. Matt steals a large sum of money confiscated from a drug bust in order to pay for Ann's treatment -- but when she apparently dies in a suspicious fire, the money disappears, and all the clues point to Matt as the culprit.

programme.title: Cop Land
programme.desc: When hotheaded Superboy (Michael Rapaport) accidentally gets involved in an ugly racially-motivated incident, his uncle Ray Donlan (Harvey Keitel), a corrupt New York City cop, attempts to sweep it under the rug by helping fake his nephew's death. The bungled cover-up leads to investigations by idealistic Internal Affairs officer Moe Tilden (Robert De Niro) and Freddy Heflin (Sylvester Stallone), sheriff of the suburban New Jersey town where Donlan and his fellow crooked policemen live.

programme.title: Treasure Island

programme.title: The Institute

programme.title: Rounders
programme.desc: Mike McDermott loses his money in a poker game against Russian gangster Teddy "KGB". Under pressure from his girlfriend, Jo, he promises to quit gambling. This lasts until his friend, Lester "Worm" Murphy, gets out of prison and needs to pay off an old debt. The pair come close to earning the money back but are caught cheating. Then Mike finds out the debt is owed to Teddy and makes one last-ditch effort to beat the Russian.

programme.title: The Thomas Crown Affair
programme.desc: Bored billionaire Thomas Crown (Pierce Brosnan) decides to entertain himself by stealing a Monet from a reputed museum. When Catherine Banning (Rene Russo), an investigator for the museum's insurance company, takes an interest in Crown, a complicated back-and-forth game with romantic undertones begins between them. In an attempt to find out where Banning's loyalties lie, Crown returns the painting and essentially turns himself in, hoping that Banning's feelings for him will lead to an escape.

programme.title: The Institute

programme.title: Sex Life
programme.desc: Academic scholar leaves it all behind to empower women to rediscover themselves through sensuality and sexuality; lesbian filmmaker sets out to redefine porn and elevate the genre; a couple explores the art of flogging with expert guide, Midori.

programme.title: To Catch a Thief
programme.desc: Notorious cat burglar John Robie (Cary Grant) has long since retired to tend vineyards on the French Riviera. When a series of robberies is committed in his style, John must clear his name. Armed with a list of people who own the most expensive jewels currently in the area, John begins following the first owner, young Francie (Grace Kelly). When her jewels are stolen, Francie suspects John, destroying their tentative romance. John goes on the lam to catch the thief and clear his own name.

programme.title: The Magnificent Seven
programme.desc: A Mexican village is at the mercy of Calvera, the leader of a band of outlaws. The townspeople, too afraid to fight for themselves, hire seven American gunslingers to free them from the bandits' raids. The professional gunmen train the villagers to defend themselves, then plan a trap for the evil Calvera.

programme.title: The Black Stallion Returns
programme.desc: Wealthy Moroccan sheik Ishak (Ferdinand Mayne), believing himself to be the true owner, dispatches his henchmen to steal a champion Arabian stallion, the Black, from its young caretaker, Alec Ramsay (Kelly Reno). Determined to recover the horse, Alec follows the sheik back to Morocco, where his pleas for the stallion's return fall on deaf ears. When Alec learns that Ishak plans to enter the Black in an upcoming race, he settles for training the horse's new jockey -- for the time being.

programme.title: Legally Blonde
programme.desc: Elle Woods (Reese Witherspoon) has it all. She wants nothing more than to be Mrs. Warner Huntington III. But there is one thing stopping him (Matthew Davis) from proposing: She is too blond. Elle rallies all of her resources and gets into Harvard, determined to win him back.

programme.title: Legally Blonde 2: Red, White & Blonde
programme.desc: Elle Woods (Reese Witherspoon) journeys to Washington, D.C., to have her say about animal rights, but is ignored by every politician she encounters and quickly learns that the White House can be even tougher to navigate than the Ivy League. Finally, Elle makes the acquaintance of sympathetic Rep. Victoria Rudd (Sally Field), who helps the young lawyer get her foot in the door of Congress. Unfortunately, Elle still has to convince the entire legislature to hear her out.

programme.title: In Too Deep
programme.desc: Drug lord Dwayne Gittens (LL Cool J) rules Cincinnati with an iron fist. No wonder he's known as God on the streets. Determined to break Gittens' stranglehold on the city is undercover cop Jeffrey Cole (Omar Epps). Supporting him in the difficult task ahead is his girlfriend (Nia Long) and his tough-as-nails commander (Stanley Tucci). But as Cole takes on an assumed identity to penetrate Gittens' criminal empire, he makes a disturbing discovery -- he kind of likes being a gangster.

programme.title: John Carpenter's Escape From L.A.
programme.desc: In 2013, the United States president was exiling all citizens who don't conform to his hyper-conservative views to Los Angeles, which became an island after a huge earthquake. But, when the president's daughter nabs the detonator to her dad's apocalyptic weapon and sneaks into L.A. to be with the rebel leader she loves, the government taps commando-turned-crook Snake Plissken to retrieve the young woman. And, if he doesn't succeed quickly, he'll be executed.

programme.title: Worldbreaker
programme.desc: A father hides his daughter on an island to keep her safe while he equips her for survival and the battles ahead.

programme.title: RoboCop
programme.desc: In a violent, near-apocalyptic Detroit, evil corporation Omni Consumer Products wins a contract from the city government to privatize the police force. To test their crime-eradicating cyborgs, the company leads street cop Alex Murphy (Peter Weller) into an armed confrontation with crime lord Boddicker (Kurtwood Smith) so they can use his body to support their untested RoboCop prototype. But when RoboCop learns of the company's nefarious plans, he turns on his masters.

programme.title: Days of Heaven
programme.desc: A screen poem about life in America at the turn of the century. A story of love and murder told through the voice of a child and expressive images of nature in 1916. A steelworker flees Chicago after a fight with his boss; he takes his little sister and girlfriend with him.

programme.title: Death Wish 4: The Crackdown
programme.desc: Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson), who is no stranger to vigilante justice, is pulled back into the underworld of Los Angeles when the daughter of his new girlfriend, Karen (Kay Lenz), dies after an overdose of crack cocaine. Intent on seeing justice served, Paul goes after the kingpin who ultimately supplied the crack. As he hunts down the kingpin's minions, Paul starts taking out a large part of the city's drug-dealing population on a violent killing spree.

programme.title: The Bridge at Remagen
programme.desc: Fatigued by the long combat in Europe, Lt. Phil Hartman (George Segal) and his men are ordered to advance on Remagen, a possible toehold into enemy territory. Meanwhile, Maj. Paul Kreuger (Robert Vaughn) of the German armed forces is ordered to defend the town and the nearby bridge across the Rhine. As a desperate battle commences, Hartman and Kreuger both find themselves pawns of larger forces and witness how war can turn each side against itself.

programme.title: Unseen
programme.desc: Sam, a gas station clerk, receives a random call from Emily, a nearly blind woman who's running from her murderous ex in the woods. Using a phone, Sam becomes Emily's only chance for survival as she guides the terrified woman through a video call.

programme.title: Fluke
programme.desc: Workaholic Thomas P. Johnson (Matthew Modine) has achieved professional success at the expense of his family life, having neglected his wife, Carol (Nancy Travis), and son, Brian (Max Pomeranc). After Johnson wrecks his car in a dangerous street race with co-worker Jeff Newman (Eric Stoltz), he finds himself watching his own funeral. Returning to Earth as a dog, Johnson finds his family and struggles to have a positive influence on their lives -- in spite of his canine form.

programme.title: Overboard
programme.desc: Kate is a single, working-class mother of three who's hired to clean a luxury yacht that belongs to Leonardo -- a selfish, spoiled and wealthy Mexican playboy. After unjustly firing Kate, Leonardo falls off the boat and wakes up with no memory of who he is. To get payback, Kate shows up at the hospital and convinces the confused amnesiac that they're married. As Leonardo tries to get used to manual labor and his new family, Kate starts to wonder how long she can keep fooling her fake husband.

programme.title: The First Wives Club
programme.desc: Despondent over the marriage of her ex-husband to a younger woman, a middle-aged divorcée plunges to her death from her penthouse. At the woman's funeral, her former college friends (Bette Midler, Goldie Hawn, Diane Keaton) reunite for the first time in nearly 30 years. When the three discover the reason for their friend's suicide, they realize that all of their ex-husbands have taken them for granted -- and deciding it's time for revenge, they make a pact to get back at their exes.

programme.title: Book Club
programme.desc: Four friends' lives are turned upside down when their book club tackles the infamous "50 Shades of Grey." From discovering new romance to rekindling old flames, they inspire each other to make their next chapter the best chapter.

programme.title: The American President
programme.desc: With the end of his first term in sight, widowed U.S. President Andrew Shepherd (Michael Douglas) knows that overwhelming public support will guarantee his re-election. But when he falls in love with lobbyist Sydney Ellen Wade (Annette Bening), Shepherd's supporters question the relationship, and his approval ratings drop. As a rival presidential candidate goes on the attack, Shepherd must choose between his political career and his love for Sydney.

programme.title: Mercy
programme.desc: In the near future, an advanced AI judge tells a captive detective that he's on trial for the murder of his wife. If he fails to prove his innocence within 90 minutes, he'll be executed on the spot.

programme.title: The Running Man
programme.desc: In the near future, "The Running Man" is the top-rated show on television, a deadly competition where contestants must survive 30 days while being hunted by professional assassins. Desperate for money to save his sick daughter, Ben Richards is convinced by the show's ruthless producer to enter the game as a last resort. Ratings soon skyrocket as Ben's defiance, instincts and grit turn him into an unexpected fan favorite, as well as a threat to the entire system.

programme.title: G.I. Joe: The Rise of Cobra
programme.desc: Armed with the latest in military and spy technology, the team of elite soldiers known as G.I. Joe travel around the globe to wherever their services are needed. In their latest assignment Gen. Hawk (Dennis Quaid), Duke (Channing Tatum) and the rest of the G.I. Joe team take on Destro (Christopher Eccleston), a corrupt arms dealer, and fight the growing threat of the mysterious Cobra organization.

programme.title: G.I. Joe: Retaliation
programme.desc: In the continuing adventures of the G.I. Joe team, Duke (Channing Tatum), second-in-command Roadblock (Dwayne Johnson), and the rest of the Joes (D.J. Cotrona, Lee Byung-hun) face a two-fold threat. Not only is their mortal enemy COBRA rearing its ugly head again, but there is also a threat from within the U.S. government: There might be an impostor in the White House. Meanwhile, Snake Eyes (Ray Park) is on a search for inner peace but learns that his nemesis, Storm Shadow, is still alive.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt and the IMF team race against time to find the Entity, a rogue artificial intelligence that can destroy mankind.

programme.desc: After Dr. Bronson (Hayden Rorke) discovers Zyra, a new planet, fellow astronomer Dr. Hendron (Larry Keating) checks Bronson's data and reaches the horrifying conclusion that Bellus, a star in Zyra's orbit, is doomed to crash into the Earth within a matter of months. Meanwhile, Hendron's daughter, Joyce (Barbara Rush), has grown fond of pilot David Randall (Richard Derr), and pleads to have him brought along as a small group is relocated to Zyra to avoid the impending mass destruction.

programme.title: Smurfs
programme.desc: When evil wizards Razamel and Gargamel take Papa Smurf, the Smurfs embark on a mission to the real world to save him. With help from some new friends, they must discover what defines their destiny to save the universe.

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog 3
programme.desc: Sonic, Knuckles and Tails reunite to battle Shadow, a mysterious new enemy with powers unlike anything they've faced before. With their abilities outmatched in every way, they seek out an unlikely alliance to stop Shadow and protect the planet.

programme.desc: Inspired by their idealistic professor, Dr. Mallery (Robert Redford), to do something meaningful with their lives, Arian (Derek Luke) and Ernest (Michael Peña) join the military and ship out to Afghanistan. Their experiences tie together two separate but related stories. In California, Mallery tries to break through to a disaffected student, while in Washington, D.C., a presidential hopeful (Tom Cruise) prepares to give a journalist (Meryl Streep) the scoop of a lifetime.

programme.title: Double Jeopardy
programme.desc: Framed for the murder of her husband, Libby Parsons (Ashley Judd) survives the long years in prison with two burning desires sustaining her -- finding her son and solving the mystery that destroyed her once-happy life. Standing between her and her quest, however, is her parole officer, Travis Lehman (Tommy Lee Jones). Libby poses a challenge to the cynical officer, one that forces him to face up to his own failings while pitting him against his superiors and law enforcement colleagues.

programme.desc: Chicago firefighting brothers Stephen (Kurt Russell) and Brian (William Baldwin) have been rivals since childhood. Brian, struggling to prove himself, transfers to the arson unit. There he aids Don (Robert De Niro) in his investigation into a spate of fires involving oxygen-induced infernos called backdrafts. But when a conspiracy implicating a crooked politician and an arsonist leads Brian back to Stephen, he is forced to overcome his brotherly competitiveness in order to crack the case.

programme.desc: Hoping for an idyllic getaway, a couple and their daughter visit a remote mansion in rural Louisiana. When suspiciously friendly neighbors show up uninvited, the weekend soon takes a sinister turn as dark secrets test the family's fragile bond.

programme.desc: Il giudice stabilisce che Patruno deve essere operato da Diego, per questo il boss viene ricoverato proprio nel reparto dove esercita Mancini. Il dottore, distrutto dal senso di colpa, cerca di fare di tutto per continuare a seguire Vanessa.

programme.title: Come fai sbagli
programme.desc: Le carriere lavorative di Zoe e di Giulio terminano in pochi giorni, sufficienti al ragazzo per capire quanto suo padre venga deriso dai colleghi per i suoi modi pomposi e gli abiti antiquati.

programme.title: Il Santone: #lepiubellefrasidiOscio
programme.sub-title: Ciò che non ti uccide ti rompe li c...
programme.desc: Quando Enzo torna dopo essere scomparso per mesi, non è più lo stesso stressato padre di famiglia di prima: indossa un mundu e ha la pace mentale di un santone indiano. La sua nuova veste attira la curiosità di tutto il quartiere.

programme.title: Gigantosaurus
programme.desc: Les quatre dinos découvrent que Missy est douée pour les tours de magie et l'encouragent à faire un spectacle de magie ; Tiny a des étoiles dans les yeux ; elle a toujours voulu faire partie d'un spectacle.

programme.title: Gigantosaurus
programme.desc: Quand Totor voit d'autres dinosaures être récompensés pour leurs talents, il part à la recherche du sien.

programme.title: Toupie et Binou [NEW]
programme.desc: Avec l'aide des enfants à la maison, Plink Plink Toupie et Plink Plink Binou trouvent le sosie parfait d'un monstre.

programme.title: Tut Tut Chrissy Bolides: les p'tites aventures
programme.desc: Chrissy et son ennemi juré, Bobby Mini Van, se livrent une compétition féroce lors de la Carcade de Mike pour remporter le prix Bébé Limoucorne.

programme.title: Harry & Bip
programme.desc: Harry trouve un magazine avec une photo passionnante de deux amis en train d'apprécier un barbecue.

programme.title: Interstellaire Ella [NEW]
programme.desc: Ella doit ajouter son souvenir à la capsule temporelle familiale, mais celle-ci a disparu! Pour la retrouver, elle devra suivre sa trace jusque sur une comète sombre et ultrarapide.

programme.title: Interstellaire Ella [NEW]
programme.desc: Slippy gagne un concours avec une photo prise grâce à son grand-père. Rongé par la culpabilité, il tente de se racheter et découvre que dire la vérité vaut mieux que gagner.

programme.title: Les ani-monstres
programme.desc: Les Ani-monstres veulent de la pizza et demandent à Bubulle et Globulle de leur rapporter leur plat préféré; toutefois, les deux petits élans ailés n'en font qu'à leur tête et n'arrivent pas à suivre les instructions.

programme.title: Contes chrono
programme.desc: Une petite gardienne d'oies rêve d'aller danser au bal ; une bonne oie-fée va lui apporter son aide.

programme.title: T'es où Chicky?
programme.desc: Chicky découvre un curieux objet aux mille couleurs.

programme.title: Garfield tout court
programme.desc: De courtes animations avec Garfield et toute sa bande.

programme.title: Carl le collectionneur [NEW]
programme.desc: Carl, Sheldon et Forêt ne sont pas d'accord sur l'histoire de leur rencontre et sur la façon dont ils sont devenus meilleurs amis pour toujours.

programme.title: Les africanimaux d'Arthur L'aventurier [NEW]
programme.desc: Au parc national du Serengeti, durant la plus grande migration de mammifères au monde, Arthur L'aventurier et sa guide Siyana partent à la rencontre d'animaux tels que le lion, le zèbre et le gnou.

programme.title: C'est Andrew!
programme.desc: À l'école, Andrew doit créer son arbre généalogique, mais étant adopté, il ne sait pas s'il doit montrer sa famille biologique ou sa famille adoptive.

programme.title: C'est Andrew!
programme.desc: Les petites cornes ne peuvent s'entendre sur la sorte de club auquel elles veulent toutes participer.

programme.title: Toupie et Binou: les fabuleuses aventures [NEW]
programme.desc: Le nouveau pyjama de Toupie a des pouvoirs qu'il ne peut pas tout à fait contrôler.

programme.title: Toupie et Binou: les fabuleuses aventures [NEW]
programme.sub-title: Toupie et Binou jouent aux quilles
programme.desc: Toupie vise les abats tandis que Binou lance la boule tranquillement et avec aisance.

programme.title: Paf le chien
programme.desc: Aujourd'hui, Lola doit faire une présentation avec Lucie devant la classe; par inadvertance, sa mère l'embarque, pensant qu'il s'agit de ses plans d'architecte; direction le musée pour Paf.

programme.title: Paf le chien
programme.desc: La maman de Lola a acheté une imprimante 3D pour son travail; la petite fille trouve ça génial, elle peut fabriquer des bracelets; d'ailleurs, tous ses copains de l'école en veulent un.

programme.title: Mini-Jean et Mini-Bulle [NEW]
programme.sub-title: Médecine douce; La mini-agence: une nouvelle image!
programme.desc: On suit Mini-Jean, Mini-Bulle et leur œil-géante-mutante Byzantin dans leurs aventures des plus farfelues aux plus déjantées.

programme.title: T'es où Chicky?
programme.desc: Becky s'amuse sur une balançoire, mais heureusement que Chicky est là.

programme.title: Wowanimo
programme.desc: On présente l'unique et surprenant cerf de Virginie.

programme.title: Les histoires d'Om Nom
programme.desc: Om Nom repart en voyage dans le temps, mais cette fois-ci avec l'aide de la télécommande temporelle du professeur Cheddar.

programme.title: Les Chapardeurs [NEW]
programme.desc: Les Chapardeurs sont des petits êtres qui vivent à notre insu dans nos maisons; la règle est simple: pour vivre en paix, ils ne doivent jamais être vus des humains; Arrietty brave les règles en devenant amie avec Tom, un humain.

programme.title: Angry Birds Toons
programme.desc: Chuck veut surprendre Matilda en lui offrant un petit cadeau : un nain de jardin que Matilda trouve extrêmement laid ; elle fait de son mieux pour s'en débarrasser discrètement, mais la tâche s'avère plus dure que prévu.

programme.title: Monde jurassique: le camp du Crétacé
programme.desc: Maintenant que Kash est pris au piège dans la grotte, Yaz, Sammy et Brooklynn partent en quête d'une maison confortable pour les bébés sino-spino; Kenji hésite à révéler à Darius sa relation avec Brooklynn.

programme.title: Prochain arrêt
programme.desc: Klaus et Mish découvrent une mystérieuse forteresse souterraine composée de galeries creusées dans la roche ; Klaus crée des clones de lui-même qu'il envoie en reconnaissance.

programme.title: Les jeux de La Fontaine
programme.desc: Au patinage artistique, la discipline des Souris leur permet de remporter la coupe face aux favoris, les Crapauds Flamboyants.

programme.title: Les Croods: (pré)histoires de famille
programme.desc: Thunk, qui s'ennuie à regarder par la fenêtre, comprend que la vie serait plus divertissante avec plus de drames; mais quand il entreprend d'en provoquer dans toute la ferme, les autres décident de lui donner une petite leçon.

programme.title: Combo [NEW]
programme.desc: Bien que le tzatziki soit une spécialité grecque, il fait partie d'une grande famille de sauces au yogourt qu'on trouve dans plusieurs régions du monde, comme en Inde et en Turquie.

programme.title: Les cochons d'Angry Birds
programme.desc: Suivant la vie de tous les jours et les problèmes de cochons espiègles.

programme.title: Défense d'entrer!
programme.desc: Lolo refuse catégoriquement de nommer Lulu fausse ministre des Communications pour Wilomax, et celle-ci est tellement fâchée qu'elle se venge; il réalise que cette décision est une grosse perte pour lui.

programme.title: Le facteur de l'espace
programme.desc: Bob a toujours travaillé en solo ; un matin, Patron lui impose une nouvelle coéquipière à l'humour déjanté : Odile ; pour Bob, il est hors de question qu'Odile l'accompagne à sa première livraison : elle doit rester dans VP1.

programme.title: Les lance-pierres d'Angry Birds
programme.desc: Un changement inattendu rapproche les oiseaux et les cochons, un peu trop à leur goût.

programme.title: Jumelles
programme.desc: Emma savoure sa liberté dans sa nouvelle chambre, tandis que Florence, perdue dans les souvenirs et le vide laissé par l'absence de sa soeur, tente de définir ce qui lui correspond vraiment.

programme.title: Savais-tu?
programme.sub-title: Le lièvre, la tortue et le renard
programme.desc: Un renard peut sentir un lièvre des heures après son passage.

programme.title: Angry Birds Toons
programme.desc: Peu de gens le savent, mais Chuck excelle au jeu de cache-cache ; cependant, ses cachettes sont parfois un peu trop bonnes.

programme.title: Combo [NEW]
programme.desc: Le sirop d'érable trouve ses origines chez les peuples autochtones d'Amérique du Nord, qui récoltaient l'eau d'érable et la faisaient bouillir pour la transformer en sucre ou en sirop.

programme.title: Les Bienvenu... ou presque!
programme.desc: Pascale réalise que Myriam porte une chaîne qui lui appartient et accuse les enfants de la lui avoir volée ; après avoir admis l'avoir prise, Léa cherche un moyen de réparer sa faute avec l'aide de Loïc ; Nick a une première expérience sur la route.

programme.title: Les gadgets d'Angry Birds
programme.desc: L'inspiration nous vient parfois de sources inattendues, comme du son d'un balai qui glisse sur le sol ; mais trouver l'inspiration pour faire du rangement, ça, c'est une autre histoire.

programme.title: Angry Birds Toons
programme.desc: Les P'tits Bleus ont une nuit agitée ; Bomb est somnambule et il transporte les œufs précieux dans des endroits dangereux autour du nid ; les P'tits Bleus essayent de lui libérer le passage sans réveiller l'oiseau explosif.

programme.title: Bernard Sports
programme.desc: Bernard, le plus malchanceux et maladroit des ours blancs, se met au sport et accumule les catastrophes. Ses amis n'ont qu'une obsession : faire mieux que lui.

programme.title: La cuisine d'Isabelle et Ricardo
programme.sub-title: Pennes, sauce crémeuse aux poivrons rôtis; Rigatonis au maquereau, aux tomates et aux câpres
programme.desc: La cheffe Isabelle Deschamps Plante poursuit la mission de Ricardo ; elle reçoit dans la même cuisine pour y préparer des recettes simples, réconfortantes et accessibles, trois jours par semaine.

programme.title: 5 chefs dans ma cuisine

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Spawned from a lab experiment gone awry, teenage terrapins Leonardo, Michelangelo, Donatello and Raphael live in the sewers beneath New York. Although their rodent sensei, Splinter, advises against showing themselves above ground, the justice-loving, pizza-eating brothers can't stand idly by while evil Shredder and his minions terrorize the city. With help from intrepid reporter April O'Neil (Megan Fox) and her cameraman (Will Arnett), the Turtles set out to save New York.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows

Along for the ride are Bebop and Rocksteady, two dimwitted henchmen who provide plenty of muscle. Luckily, the turtles have their own allies in April O'Neil, Vernon Fenwick and Casey Jones, a hockey-masked vigilante. As the pizza-loving heroes prepare for battle, the notorious Krang also emerges to pose an even greater threat.

programme.title: Legally Blonde

programme.title: Meet the Fockers
programme.desc: Now that Greg Focker is "in" with his soon-to-be in-laws, Jack and Dina Byrnes, it looks like smooth sailing for him and his fiancée, Pam. But that's before Pam's parents meet Greg's parents, the Fockers. The hyper-relaxed Fockers and the tightly-wound Byrnes are woefully mismatched from the start, and no matter how hard Greg and Pam try, there is just no bringing their families together. This all adds up to a disastrously funny time of getting to know you.

programme.desc: When yet another anniversary passes without a marriage proposal from her boyfriend, Anna (Amy Adams) decides to take action. Aware of a Celtic tradition that allows women to pop the question on Feb. 29, she plans to follow her lover to Dublin and ask him to marry her. programme.title: How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days

Enter executive Ben Berry (Matthew McConaughey), who is so confident in his romantic prowess that he thinks he can make any woman fall in love with him in 10 days. When Andie and Ben meet, their plans backfire.

programme.title: Boundless
programme.desc: Adventure junkies Simon Donato and Paul "Turbo" Trebilcock try to prove that boundaries are meant to be broken as they test their limits in some of the world's toughest endurance races. Donato, who holds a doctorate in geology, is the brains of the duo and a self-proclaimed nomad. Trebilcock, a dedicated athlete with a background in running, is considered the heart of the team. Together, they participate in competitions that include a seven-day race through volcanic terrain in Iceland, a 46-mile foot race with obstacles, and a 142-mile run through Cambodian jungles. From running, biking, skiing, swimming and climbing, their love for the rush coupled with their undeniable stamina makes it a wild ride with a few cuts and bruised egos along the way. Endurance athletes Rory Bosio and Hunter McIntyre join the team beginning in Season 3.

programme.title: Boundless
programme.desc: Adventure junkies Simon Donato and Paul "Turbo" Trebilcock try to prove that boundaries are meant to be broken as they test their limits in some of the world's toughest endurance races. Donato, who holds a doctorate in geology, is the brains of the duo and a self-proclaimed nomad. Trebilcock, a dedicated athlete with a background in running, is considered the heart of the team. Together, they participate in competitions that include a seven-day race through volcanic terrain in Iceland, a 46-mile foot race with obstacles, and a 142-mile run through Cambodian jungles. From running, biking, skiing, swimming and climbing, their love for the rush coupled with their undeniable stamina makes it a wild ride with a few cuts and bruised egos along the way. Endurance athletes Rory Bosio and Hunter McIntyre join the team beginning in Season 3.
